sourceText: ንጉሡ ሄሮድስም ሰምቶ ደነገጠ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር፤
englishOfProposed: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
note: Amharic says: And King Herod heard it and was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him. Herod hearing and being troubled with all Jerusalem is only v3.

sourceText: ከዚህ በኋላ ሄሮድስ ሰብአ ሰገልን በስውር ጠርቶ ኮከቡ የታየበትን ዘመን ከእነርሱ በጥንቃቄ ተረዳ፥
englishOfProposed: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
note: Amharic says: Then Herod secretly called the wise men and learned from them carefully the time the star appeared. Herod secretly calling the magi and asking about the star's time is v7.

sourceText: ከዚህ በኋላ ሄሮድስ ሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተሣለቁበት ባየ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቆጣና ልኮ ከሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተረዳው ዘመን በቤተ ልሔምና በአውራጃዋ የነበሩትን፥ ሁለት ዓመት የሆናቸውን ከዚያም የሚያንሱትን ሕፃናት ሁሉ አስገደለ።
englishOfProposed: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.
note: Amharic says: Then Herod, seeing the wise men had mocked him, was very angry and sent and killed all the children in Bethlehem and its district two years old and under, by the time he learned from the magi. Mocked by the magi and the killing of children two years and under is v16.

sourceText: ሄሮድስም ከሞተ በኋላ፥ እነሆ፥ የጌታ መልአክ በግብፅ ለዮሴፍ በሕልም ታይቶ።
englishOfProposed: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
note: Amharic says: When Herod had died, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream in Egypt. Herod's death and the angel appearing to Joseph in Egypt is v19.

sourceText: በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ። የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮህ ሰው ድምፅ የተባለለት ይህ ነውና።
englishOfProposed: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”
note: Amharic says: This is he of whom it was said by the prophet Isaiah: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Prepare the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.' Isaiah and the voice crying 'prepare the way of the Lord' is v3.

sourceText: የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይህ ሆነ። ከዚያ ዘመን ጀምሮ ኢየሱስ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለችና ንስሐ ግቡ እያለ ይሰብክ ጀመር።
englishOfProposed: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
note: Amharic says: This happened so that what was spoken might be fulfilled. From that time Jesus began to preach, saying, 'Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.' Opens with the fulfilment formula of v14 ('that what was spoken might be fulfilled') then gives all of v17 ('from that time Jesus began to preach, repent'); v15-16 are missing. The text seems to hold words from more than one verse, so putting it under one number may be wrong; leaving the range unavailable may be best.

sourceText: የሚወዱአችሁን ብትወዱ ምን ዋጋ አላችሁ? ቀራጮችስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?
englishOfProposed: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
note: Amharic says: If you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Do not the tax collectors do the same? Loving those who love you and the tax collectors doing the same is v46.

sourceText: ስትጸልዩም እንደ ግብዞች አትሁኑ፤ ለሰው ይታዩ ዘንድ በምኩራብና በመንገድ ማዕዘን ቆመው መጸለይን ይወዳሉና፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋቸውን ተቀብለዋል።
englishOfProposed: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.
note: Amharic says: When you pray, do not be like the hypocrites, for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and street corners to be seen by people; truly I say to you, they have received their reward. Praying like hypocrites in synagogues and street corners is v5.

sourceText: ብልና ዝገት በሚያጠፉት ሌቦችም ቆፍረው በሚሠርቁት ዘንድ ለእናንተ በምድር ላይ መዝገብ አትሰብስቡ፤
englishOfProposed: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;
note: Amharic says: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy and thieves dig through and steal. Treasures on earth, moth, rust and thieves is v19.

sourceText: በወንድምህም ዓይን ያለውን ጉድፍ ስለምን ታያለህ፥ በዓይንህ ግን ያለውን ምሰሶ ስለ ምን አትመለከትም?
englishOfProposed: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
note: Amharic says: Why do you see the speck in your brother's eye but do not notice the beam in your own eye? Speck in the brother's eye versus the beam in your own is v3.

sourceText: ኢየሱስም ብዙ ሰዎች ሲከቡት አይቶ ወደ ማዶ እንዲሻገሩ አዘዘ።
englishOfProposed: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.
note: Amharic says: When Jesus saw many people surrounding him, he commanded them to cross to the other side. Jesus seeing the crowds and ordering a crossing to the other side is v18.

sourceText: ካህናትም በሰንበት በመቅደስ ሰንበትን እንዲያረክሱ ኃጢአትም እንዳይሆንባቸው በሕጉ አላነበባችሁምን?
englishOfProposed: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?
note: Amharic says: Have you not read in the law that the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath on the Sabbath and it is not counted as sin? Priests profaning the Sabbath in the temple and being blameless is v5.

sourceText: እነሆ የመረጥሁት ብላቴናዬ፥ ነፍሴ ደስ የተሰኘችበት ወዳጄ፤ መንፈሴን በእርሱ ላይ አኖራለሁ፥ ፍርድንም ለአሕዛብ ያወራል።
englishOfProposed: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
note: Amharic says: Behold my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul delights; I will put my Spirit on him and he will proclaim judgment to the Gentiles. The Isaiah quote 'behold my servant whom I have chosen' is v18; no fulfilment formula (v17) or charge to silence (v16).

sourceText: በዚያን ጊዜ ሕዝቡን ትቶ ወደ ቤት ገባ። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። የእርሻውን እንክርዳድ ምሳሌ ተርጕምልን አሉት።
englishOfProposed: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
note: Amharic says: Then he left the crowd and went into the house; his disciples came to him and said, 'Explain to us the parable of the weeds of the field.' Leaving the crowd, entering the house, and asking about the parable of the tares is v36.

sourceText: እርሱ ግን መልሶ ከእነርሱ ለአንዱ እንዲህ አለው። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ አልበደልሁህም በአንድ ዲናር አልተስማማኸኝምን?
englishOfProposed: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?
note: Amharic says: But he answered one of them, 'Friend, I do you no wrong; did you not agree with me for one denarius?' 'Friend, I do you no wrong ... one denarius' is v13.

sourceText: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሄደው ኢየሱስ እንዳዘዛቸው አደረጉ፥
englishOfProposed: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,
note: Amharic says: The disciples went and did as Jesus had commanded them. Disciples going and doing as Jesus commanded is v6.

sourceText: ሕዝቡም ይህን ሰምተው በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ።
englishOfProposed: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
note: Amharic says: And the people, hearing this, were amazed at his teaching. The crowd hearing and being astonished at his teaching is v33.

sourceText: ዳዊትስ ጌታ ብሎ ከጠራው፥ እንዴት ልጁ ይሆናል? አላቸው።
englishOfProposed: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”
note: Amharic says: If David then calls him Lord, how is he his son? he said to them. The conditional 'if David calls him Lord, how is he his son' is v45 (v43 asks how David calls him Lord and introduces the quote).

sourceText: ኢየሱስም ቀረበና እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው። ሥልጣን ሁሉ በሰማይና በምድር ተሰጠኝ።
englishOfProposed: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
note: Amharic says: Jesus came near and spoke to them thus: 'All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.' 'All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me' is v18.

sourceText: ዮሐንስ በምድረ በዳ እያጠመቀ የንስሐንም ጥምቀት ለኃጢአት ስርየት እየሰበከ መጣ።
englishOfProposed: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
note: Amharic says: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins. John baptizing in the wilderness, preaching repentance for remission of sins, is v4.

sourceText: በገሊላ ባሕርም አጠገብ ሲያልፍ ስምዖንን ወንድሙንም እንድርያስን መረባቸውን ወደ ባሕር ሲጥሉ አየ፥ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ነበሩና።
englishOfProposed: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
note: Amharic says: Passing along the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting their nets into the sea, for they were fishermen. Simon and Andrew casting nets by the Sea of Galilee is v16.

sourceText: ሌላውም ብዙ መሬት በሌለበት በጭንጫ ላይ ወደቀና ጥልቅ መሬት ስላልነበረው ወዲያው በቀለ፤
englishOfProposed: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
note: Amharic says: Other seed fell on rocky ground where there was not much soil, and because it had no depth of soil it sprang up at once. Seed on stony ground without much earth springing up quickly is v5.

sourceText: አላቸውም። ይህን ምሳሌ አታውቁምን? እንዴትስ ምሳሌዎቹን ሁሉ ታውቃላችሁ?
englishOfProposed: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?
note: Amharic says: And he said to them, 'Do you not understand this parable? How then will you understand all the parables?' 'Don't you know this parable? How will you know all parables?' is v13.

sourceText: እነርሱም ነገሩን አላስተዋሉም፥ እንዳይጠይቁትም ፈሩ።
englishOfProposed: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
note: Amharic says: But they did not understand the saying and were afraid to ask him. Not understanding the saying and fearing to ask is v32.

sourceText: ሰው ሁሉ በእሳት ይቀመማልና፥ መሥዋዕትም ሁሉ በጨው ይቀመማል።
englishOfProposed: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.
note: Amharic says: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be salted with salt. Salted with fire and every sacrifice salted with salt is v49.

sourceText: ምሳሌውንም ስለ እነርሱ እንደ ተናገረ አውቀዋልና ሊይዙት ፈለጉ፥ ነገር ግን ሕዝቡን ፈሩ። ትተውትም ሄዱ።
englishOfProposed: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.
note: Amharic says: For they knew he had spoken the parable about them, and they sought to seize him, but they feared the crowd; and they left him and went away. Seeking to seize him, fearing the people, knowing the parable was against them, is v12.

sourceText: የመበለቶችን ቤት የሚበሉ ጸሎታቸውንም በማስረዘም የሚያመካኙ እነዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ይቀበላሉ።
englishOfProposed: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
note: Amharic says: These who devour widows' houses and make long prayers as a pretext will receive greater condemnation. Devouring widows' houses and long prayers is v40.

sourceText: ምስክርነታቸውም እንዲሁ እንኳ አልተሰማማም።
englishOfProposed: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.
note: Amharic says: And even so their testimony did not agree. 'Even so their witness did not agree' is v59.

sourceText: አሁንም በመሸ ጊዜ የሰንበት ዋዜማ የሆነ የማዘጋጀት ቀን ስለ ነበረ፥ የከበረ አማካሪ የሆነ የአርማትያስ ዮሴፍ መጣ፥
englishOfProposed: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
note: Amharic says: Now when evening came, since it was the day of preparation, the eve of the Sabbath, Joseph of Arimathea, an honoured council member, came, Evening of preparation day before the Sabbath is v42, but the clause 'Joseph of Arimathea, a respected councillor, came' is v43 content pulled forward by Amharic word order (the next verse holds the rest of v43); v42 is still the best number. The text seems to hold words from more than one verse, so putting it under one number may be wrong; leaving the range unavailable may be best.

sourceText: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሄሮድስ ዘመን ከአብያ ክፍል የሆነ ዘካርያስ የሚባል አንድ ካህን ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም ከአሮን ልጆች ነበረች፥ ስምዋም ኤልሳቤጥ ነበረ።
englishOfProposed: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
note: Amharic says: In the days of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah of the division of Abijah; his wife was of the daughters of Aaron and her name was Elizabeth. Zechariah, Abijah, Herod and Elizabeth are v5.

sourceText: በስድስተኛውም ወር መልአኩ ገብርኤል ናዝሬት ወደምትባል ወደ ገሊላ ከተማ፥
englishOfProposed: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,
note: Amharic says: In the sixth month the angel Gabriel, to a city of Galilee called Nazareth, The sixth month, Gabriel and Nazareth in Galilee are v26 (the verb 'was sent' is carried into the next Amharic verse).

sourceText: ማርያምም ሦስት ወር የሚያህል በእርስዋ ዘንድ ተቀመጠች ወደ ቤትዋም ተመለሰች።
englishOfProposed: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
note: Amharic says: Mary stayed with her about three months and returned to her home. Mary staying about three months and returning home is v56.

sourceText: ማዳኑም ከወደረኞቻችንና ከሚጠሉን ሁሉ እጅ ነው፤
englishOfProposed: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;
note: Amharic says: His salvation is from the hand of our enemies and all who hate us. Salvation from our enemies and from all who hate us is v71.

sourceText: ደግሞም አንተ ሕፃን ሆይ፥ የልዑል ነቢይ ትባላለህ፥ መንገዱን ልትጠርግ በጌታ ፊት ትሄዳለህና፤
englishOfProposed: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
note: Amharic says: And you, child, will be called prophet of the Most High, for you will go before the Lord to prepare his way. 'You, child, will be called prophet of the Most High' is v76.

sourceText: በዚያም ሳሉ የመውለጃዋ ወራት ደረሰ፥
englishOfProposed: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
note: Amharic says: While they were there, the days of her delivery came. While they were there, the time to give birth came, is v6.

sourceText: እነሆም፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ስምዖን የሚባል ሰው ነበረ፥ ይህም ሰው የእስራኤልን መጽናናት ይጠባበቅ ነበር፤ ጻድቅና ትጉህም ነበረ፥ መንፈስ ቅዱስም በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።
englishOfProposed: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
note: Amharic says: And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem named Simeon; this man waited for the consolation of Israel; he was righteous and devout, and the Holy Spirit was on him. Simeon in Jerusalem awaiting the consolation of Israel is v25.

sourceText: ይህም ለአሕዛብ ሁሉን የሚገልጥ ብርሃን ለሕዝብህም ለእስራኤል ክብር ነው።
englishOfProposed: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
note: Amharic says: This is a light that reveals to the Gentiles and glory for your people Israel. Light to the Gentiles and glory of Israel is v32.

sourceText: ከአሴር ወገንም የምትሆን የፋኑኤል ልጅ ሐና የምትባል አንዲት ነቢይት ነበረች፤ እርስዋም ከድንግልናዋ ጀምራ ከባልዋ ጋር ሰባት ዓመት ኖረች፤
englishOfProposed: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
note: Amharic says: There was a prophetess named Anna, daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher; she had lived with her husband seven years from her virginity. Anna, Phanuel, Asher and seven years of marriage are v36.

sourceText: ስለዚህ ከእርሱ ሊጠመቁ ለወጡት ሕዝብ እንዲህ ይላቸው ነበር። እናንተ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ከሚመጣው ቍጣ እንድትሸሹ ማን አመለከታችሁ?
englishOfProposed: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
note: Amharic says: So he would say to the people who came out to be baptized by him, 'You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?' 'Brood of vipers, who warned you to flee the wrath to come' is v7.

sourceText: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ጌታን አምላክህን አትፈታተነው ተብሎአል አለው።
englishOfProposed: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”
note: Amharic says: Jesus answered, 'It is said: do not test the Lord your God.' Jesus' reply 'do not tempt the Lord your God' is v12.

sourceText: መጽሐፉንም ጠቅልሎ ለአገልጋዩ ሰጠውና ተቀመጠ፤ በምኵራብም የነበሩት ሁሉ ትኵር ብለው ይመለከቱት ነበር።
englishOfProposed: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
note: Amharic says: He rolled up the book, gave it to the attendant, and sat down; and all in the synagogue were staring at him. Closing the book, handing it to the attendant, sitting, eyes fixed on him is v20.

sourceText: የሰው ልጅ የሰንበት ጌታ ነው አላቸውም።
englishOfProposed: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
note: Amharic says: And he said to them, 'The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.' 'The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath' is v5.

sourceText: ለሁሉም እንዲህ አላቸው። በኋላዬ ሊመጣ የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ ራሱን ይካድ መስቀሉንም ዕለት ዕለት ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ።
englishOfProposed: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
note: Amharic says: He said to all: 'If anyone wants to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross daily and follow me.' Deny himself, take up his cross daily and follow me is v23.

sourceText: እናንተ ሕግ አዋቂዎች፥ የእውቀትን መክፈቻ ስለ ወሰዳችሁ፥ ወዮላችሁ ራሳችሁ አልገባችሁም የሚገቡትንም ከለከላችሁ።
englishOfProposed: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”
note: Amharic says: Woe to you lawyers, because you have taken away the key of knowledge; you did not enter yourselves and hindered those entering. Woe to lawyers and the key of knowledge is v52.

sourceText: ኢየሱስንም የትኛው እንደ ሆነ ሊያይ ይፈልግ ነበር፤ ቁመቱም አጭር ነበረና ስለ ሕዝቡ ብዛት አቃተው።
englishOfProposed: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
note: Amharic says: He wanted to see which one Jesus was, but because he was short he could not, because of the crowd. Seeking to see Jesus but being short and blocked by the crowd is v3.

sourceText: ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ደግሞ ሞተች።
englishOfProposed: Afterward the woman also died.
note: Amharic says: Last of all the woman also died. 'Last of all the woman also died' is v32.

sourceText: እንግዲህ ዳዊት። ጌታ ብሎ ይጠራዋል፥ እንዴትስ ልጁ ይሆናል?
englishOfProposed: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”
note: Amharic says: So David calls him Lord; how then is he his son? 'David calls him Lord, how is he his son' is v44.

sourceText: ጌታም። ስምዖን ስምዖን ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰይጣን እንደ ስንዴ ሊያበጥራችሁ ለመነ፤
englishOfProposed: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,
note: Amharic says: And the Lord said, 'Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has asked to sift you like wheat.' 'Simon, Simon, Satan desired to sift you as wheat' is v31.

sourceText: ሁላቸውም በአንድነት። ይህን አስወግድ፥ በርባንንም ፍታልን እያሉ ጮኹ፤
englishOfProposed: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—
note: Amharic says: They all cried out together, 'Away with this man, and release Barabbas to us!' Crying out together to release Barabbas is v18.

sourceText: በዚያን ጊዜ ተራራዎችን። በላያችን ውደቁ፥ ኮረብቶችንም። ሰውሩን ይሉ ዘንድ ይጀምራሉ፤
englishOfProposed: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’
note: Amharic says: Then they will begin to say to the mountains, 'Fall on us,' and to the hills, 'Cover us.' Saying to the mountains 'fall on us' and hills 'cover us' is v30.

sourceText: ይህንም ለሐዋርያት የነገሩአቸው መግደላዊት ማርያምና ዮሐና የያዕቆብም እናት ማርያም ከእነርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ሌሎች ሴቶች ነበሩ።
englishOfProposed: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.
note: Amharic says: Those who told this to the apostles were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them. The named women who told the apostles are v10.

sourceText: እነርሱም በመንገድ የሆነውን እንጀራውንም በቈረሰ ጊዜ እንዴት እንደ ታወቀላቸው ተረኩላቸው።
englishOfProposed: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.
note: Amharic says: They told what happened on the road and how he was made known to them when he broke the bread. Telling what happened on the road and the breaking of bread is v35.

sourceText: ዮሐንስ መልሶ። እኔ በውኃ አጠምቃለሁ፤ ዳሩ ግን እናንተ የማታውቁት በመካከላችሁ ቆሞአል፤
englishOfProposed: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
note: Amharic says: John answered, 'I baptize with water, but among you stands one you do not know.' 'I baptize with water; one stands among you whom you do not know' is v26.

sourceText: መጥታችሁ እዩ አላቸው። መጥተው የሚኖርበትን አዩ፥ በዚያም ቀን በእርሱ ዘንድ ዋሉ፤ አሥር ሰዓት ያህል ነበረ።
englishOfProposed: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
note: Amharic says: He said to them, 'Come and see.' They came and saw where he stayed and remained with him that day; it was about the tenth hour. 'Come and see' and the tenth hour are v39.

sourceText: ከዮሐንስ ዘንድ ሰምተው ከተከተሉት ከሁለቱ አንዱ የስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ወንድም እንድርያስ ነበረ።
englishOfProposed: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 40.

sourceText: እርሱ አስቀድሞ የራሱን ወንድም ስምዖንን አገኘውና። መሢሕን አግኝተናል አለው፤ ትርጓሜውም ክርስቶስ ማለት ነው።
englishOfProposed: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 41.

sourceText: ወደ ኢየሱስም አመጣው። ኢየሱስም ተመልክቶ። አንተ የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ነህ፤ አንተ ኬፋ ትባላለህ አለው፤ ትርጓሜው ጴጥሮስ ማለት ነው።
englishOfProposed: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 42.

sourceText: በነገው ኢየሱስ ወደ ገሊላ ሊወጣ ወደደ፥ ፊልጶስንም አገኘና። ተከተለኝ አለው።
englishOfProposed: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 43.

sourceText: ፊልጶስም ከእንድርያስና ከጴጥሮስ ከተማ ከቤተ ሳይዳ ነበረ።
englishOfProposed: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 44.

sourceText: ፊልጶስ ናትናኤልን አግኝቶ። ሙሴ በሕግ ነቢያትም ስለ እርሱ የጻፉትን የዮሴፍን ልጅ የናዝሬቱን ኢየሱስን አግኝተነዋል አለው።
englishOfProposed: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 45.

sourceText: ናትናኤልም። ከናዝሬት መልካም ነገር ሊወጣ ይችላልን? አለው። ፊልጶስ። መጥተህ እይ አለው።
englishOfProposed: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 46.

sourceText: ኢየሱስ ናትናኤልን ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አይቶ ስለ እርሱ። ተንኰል የሌለበት በእውነት የእስራኤል ሰው እነሆ አለ።
englishOfProposed: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 47.

sourceText: ናትናኤልም። ከወዴት ታውቀኛለህ? አለው። ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ፊልጶስ ሳይጠራህ፥ ከበለስ በታች ሳለህ፥ አየሁህ አለው።
englishOfProposed: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 48.

sourceText: ናትናኤልም መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ፤ አንተ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ነህ አለው።
englishOfProposed: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 49.

sourceText: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ከበለስ በታች አየሁህ ስላልሁህ አመንህን? ከዚህ የሚበልጥ ነገር ታያለህ አለው።
englishOfProposed: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 50.

sourceText: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰማይ ሲከፈት የእግዚአብሔርም መላእክት በሰው ልጅ ላይ ሲወጡና ሲወርዱ ታያላችሁ አለው።
englishOfProposed: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
note: The source numbers John 1 one verse too high from here on; this text matches standard verse 51.

sourceText: በፋሲካ በዓልም በኢየሩሳሌም ሳለ፥ ያደረገውን ምልክት ባዩ ጊዜ ብዙ ሰዎች በስሙ አመኑ፤
englishOfProposed: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.
note: Amharic says: While he was in Jerusalem at the Passover feast, many believed in his name when they saw the signs he did. Passover in Jerusalem and many believing on seeing his signs is v23.

sourceText: በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዲኖረው እንጂ እንዳይጠፋ እግዚአብሔር አንድያ ልጁን እስኪሰጥ ድረስ ዓለሙን እንዲሁ ወዶአልና።
englishOfProposed: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
note: Amharic says: For God so loved the world that he gave his only Son, so that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life. 'God so loved the world ... gave his only Son' is v16; the shared clause 'whoever believes should not perish' is part of v16, with nothing from the serpent of v14.

sourceText: በሰማርያም ሊያልፍ ግድ ሆነበት።
englishOfProposed: He needed to pass through Samaria.
note: Amharic says: And he had to pass through Samaria. Having to pass through Samaria is v4.

sourceText: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቃሌን የሚሰማ የላከኝንም የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፥ ከሞትም ወደ ሕይወት ተሻገረ እንጂ ወደ ፍርድ አይመጣም።
englishOfProposed: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
note: Amharic says: Truly, truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life; he will not come into judgment but has passed from death to life. Hearing my word, eternal life, passing from death to life is v24.

sourceText: እኔ ከራሴ አንዳች ላደርግ አይቻለኝም፤ እንደ ሰማሁ እፈርዳለሁ ፍርዴም ቅን ነው፥ የላከኝን ፈቃድ እንጂ ፈቃዴን አልሻምና።
englishOfProposed: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
note: Amharic says: I can do nothing of myself; as I hear I judge, and my judgment is right, for I seek not my will but the will of him who sent me. 'I can do nothing of myself ... I seek not my own will' is v30.

sourceText: እኔ በአባቴ ስም መጥቻለሁ አልተቀበላችሁኝምም፤ ሌላው በራሱ ስም ቢመጣ እርሱን ትቀበሉታላችሁ።
englishOfProposed: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
note: Amharic says: I have come in my Father's name and you do not receive me; if another comes in his own name, you will receive him. Coming in the Father's name and another coming in his own name is v43.

sourceText: ከዚህም በረት ያልሆኑ ሌሎች በጎች አሉኝ፤ እነርሱን ደግሞ ላመጣ ይገባኛል ድምፄንም ይሰማሉ፥ አንድም መንጋ ይሆናሉ እረኛውም አንድ።
englishOfProposed: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
note: Amharic says: I have other sheep not of this fold; I must bring them too, and they will hear my voice, and there will be one flock and one shepherd. Other sheep not of this fold, one flock one shepherd, is v16.

sourceText: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ይህን ነገር በመጀመሪያ አላስተዋሉም፤ ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ ከከበረ በኋላ በዚያን ጊዜ ይህ ስለ እርሱ እንደ ተጻፈ ይህንም እንዳደረጉለት ትዝ አላቸው።
englishOfProposed: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
note: Amharic says: His disciples did not understand this at first, but after Jesus was glorified they remembered that this was written of him and that they had done this to him. Disciples not understanding at first and remembering after his glorification is v16.

sourceText: ክብሩን ስለ አየ ኢሳይያስ ይህን አለ፥ ስለ እርሱም ተናገረ።
englishOfProposed: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
note: Amharic says: Isaiah said this because he saw his glory, and he spoke of him. Isaiah saying this when he saw his glory is v41.

sourceText: እርሱም ዓለም የማያየውና የማያውቀው ስለ ሆነ ሊቀበለው የማይቻለው የእውነት መንፈስ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ዘንድ ስለሚኖር በውሥጣችሁም ስለሚሆን እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ።
englishOfProposed: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
note: Amharic says: He is the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive because it neither sees nor knows him; but you know him, for he dwells with you and will be in you. The Spirit of truth whom the world cannot receive is v17.

sourceText: ስለ ፍርድም፥ የዚህ ዓለም ገዥ ስለ ተፈረደበት ነው።
englishOfProposed: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
note: Amharic says: And about judgment, because the ruler of this world has been judged. 'about judgment' and 'ruler of this world judged' match only v11.

sourceText: እውነተኛ አምላክ ብቻ የሆንህ አንተን የላክኸውንም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ያውቁ ዘንድ ይህች የዘላለም ሕይወት ናት።
englishOfProposed: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
note: Amharic says: This is eternal life, that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you sent. 'eternal life', 'only true God', 'Jesus Christ whom you sent' are v3.

sourceText: አባት ሆይ፥ ዓለም ሳይፈጠር ስለ ወደድኸኝ የሰጠኸኝን ክብሬን እንዲያዩ እኔ ባለሁበት የሰጠኸኝ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከእኔ ጋር ይሆኑ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ።
englishOfProposed: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
note: Amharic says: Father, I want those you gave me to be with me where I am, so they see my glory you gave me because you loved me before the world was made. 'where I am', 'see my glory', 'loved me before the world was created' are v24.

sourceText: ደግሞ አርባ ቀን እየታያቸው ስለ እግዚአብሔርም መንግሥት ነገር እየነገራቸው፥ በብዙ ማስረጃ ከሕማማቱ በኋላ ሕያው ሆኖ ለእነርሱ ራሱን አሳያቸው።
englishOfProposed: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.
note: Amharic says: Appearing to them forty days and speaking of the kingdom of God, he showed himself alive to them after his suffering with many proofs. 'forty days', 'kingdom of God', 'alive after his suffering' are v3.

sourceText: ኢዮስጦስም የሚሉትን በርስያን የተባለውን ዮሴፍንና ማትያስን ሁለቱን አቆሙ።
englishOfProposed: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.
note: Amharic says: They put forward two, Joseph called Barsabbas who was called Justus, and Matthias. Names Justus, Barsabbas, Joseph and Matthias and 'the two' are v23.

sourceText: ዕጣም ተጣጣሉላቸው፥ ዕጣውም ለማትያስ ወደቀና ከአሥራ አንዱ ሐዋርያት ጋር ተቈጠረ።
englishOfProposed: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.
note: Amharic says: They cast lots for them, and the lot fell to Matthias, and he was counted with the eleven apostles. 'cast lots', 'fell to Matthias', 'eleven apostles' are v26.

sourceText: አለ። እንግዲህ ይህን እናንተ የሰቀላችሁትን ኢየሱስን እግዚአብሔር ጌታም ክርስቶስም እንዳደረገው የእስራኤል ወገን ሁሉ በእርግጥ ይወቅ።
englishOfProposed: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”
note: Amharic says: [He] said. So let all the house of Israel know for certain that God made this Jesus whom you crucified both Lord and Christ. Body is v36 ('Jesus whom you crucified', 'Lord and Christ', 'all Israel know'), but the leading stray word 'he said' closes the v34-35 quotation. The text seems to hold words from more than one verse, so putting it under one number may be wrong; leaving the range unavailable may be best.

sourceText: እግዚአብሔር ከጥንት ጀምሮ በቅዱሳን ነቢያቱ አፍ የተናገረው፥ ነገር ሁሉ እስከሚታደስበት ዘመን ድረስ ሰማይ ይቀበለው ዘንድ ይገባልና።
englishOfProposed: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.
note: Amharic says: Whom heaven must receive until the time of restoration of all things, which God spoke from of old by the mouth of his holy prophets. 'heaven must receive', 'restoration of all things', 'holy prophets' are v21.

sourceText: እነርሱንም በመካከል አቁመው። በምን ኃይል ወይስ በማን ስም እናንተ ይህን አደረጋችሁ? ብለው ጠየቁአቸው።
englishOfProposed: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”
note: Amharic says: Having set them in the middle, they asked them: By what power or in whose name did you do this? 'by what power or what name did you do this' is v7.

sourceText: ከጸለዩም በኋላ ተሰብስበው የነበሩበት ስፍራ ተናወጠ፥ በሁሉም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባቸው፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል በግልጥ ተናገሩ።
englishOfProposed: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
note: Amharic says: After they prayed, the place where they were gathered was shaken, they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke God's word boldly. 'after they prayed', 'place shaken', 'filled with Holy Spirit', 'spoke the word boldly' are v31.

sourceText: የመቅደስ አዛዥና የካህናት አለቆችም ይህን ነገር በሰሙ ጊዜ። እንጃ ይህ ምን ይሆን? እያሉ ስለ እነርሱ አመነቱ።
englishOfProposed: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
note: Amharic says: When the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard this, they were perplexed about them, saying: what will this become? 'captain of the temple and chief priests heard', 'perplexed' are v24.

sourceText: እርሱም ወገናችንን ተተንኵሎ ሕፃናትን በሕይወት እንዳይጠብቁ ወደ ውጭ ይጥሉ ዘንድ አድርጎ አባቶቻችንን አስጨነቀ።
englishOfProposed: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.
note: Amharic says: He dealt craftily with our people and oppressed our fathers, making them cast out their infants so they would not live. 'oppressed our fathers', 'cast out infants' are v19.

sourceText: ጌታም። የቆምህባት ስፍራ የተቀደሰች ምድር ናትና የእግርህን ጫማ አውልቅ።
englishOfProposed: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
note: Amharic says: The Lord said: Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground. 'take off your sandals', 'holy ground' are v33.

sourceText: እናንተ አንገተ ደንዳኖች ልባችሁና ጆሮአችሁም ያልተገረዘ፥ እናንተ ሁልጊዜ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ትቃወማላችሁ፤ አባቶቻችሁ እንደ ተቃወሙት እናንተ ደግሞ።
englishOfProposed: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
note: Amharic says: You stiff-necked, uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, so do you. 'stiff-necked', 'uncircumcised heart and ears', 'resist the Holy Spirit' are v51.

sourceText: ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ በልባቸው በጣም ተቈጡ ጥርሳቸውንም አፋጩበት።
englishOfProposed: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
note: Amharic says: When they heard this they were furious in their hearts and gnashed their teeth at him. 'heard this', 'enraged', 'gnashed teeth' are v54.

sourceText: የሁሉ ጌታ በሚሆን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሰላምን እየሰበከ ይህን ቃል ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ላከ።
englishOfProposed: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
note: Amharic says: He sent this word to the children of Israel, preaching peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all. 'sent this word to Israel', 'peace through Jesus Christ', 'Lord of all' are v36.

sourceText: በወጡም ጊዜ ይህን ነገር በሚመጣው ሰንበት ይነግሩአቸው ዘንድ ለመኑአቸው።
englishOfProposed: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.
note: Amharic says: As they went out, they begged them to tell them these things on the next Sabbath. 'as they went out', 'next Sabbath' are v42.

sourceText: በየቤተ ክርስቲያኑም ሽማግሌዎችን ከሾሙላቸው በኋላ ጦመውም ከጸለዩ በኋላ፥ ላመኑበት ለጌታ አደራ ሰጡአቸው።
englishOfProposed: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.
note: Amharic says: After appointing elders for them in each church and praying with fasting, they committed them to the Lord in whom they believed. 'appointed elders in each church', 'fasting and praying', 'committed to the Lord' are v23.

sourceText: ከጥንት ጀምሮ ሥራው ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የታወቀ ነው።
englishOfProposed: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.
note: Amharic says: From of old all his works are known to God. 'known from of old' matches only v18 (KJV 'Known unto God are all his works').

sourceText: ራሳቸውም ደግሞ በቃላቸው ያንኑ ይነግሩአችሁ ዘንድ ይሁዳንና ሲላስን ልከናል።
englishOfProposed: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.
note: Amharic says: We have sent Judas and Silas so that they themselves may tell you the same by word of mouth. 'Judas and Silas', 'tell you in person' are v27.

sourceText: እነርሱም ተሰናብተው ወደ አንጾኪያ ወረዱ፥ ሕዝቡንም ሰብስበው ደብዳቤውን ሰጡአቸው።
englishOfProposed: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
note: Amharic says: They were dismissed and went down to Antioch, gathered the people and delivered the letter. 'went down to Antioch', 'gathered the congregation', 'gave the letter' are v30.

sourceText: የአቴና ሰዎች ሁሉና በዚያ የኖሩ እንግዶች አዲስ ነገርን ከመናገርና ከመስማት በቀር በሌላ ጉዳይ አይውሉም ነበርና።
englishOfProposed: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.
note: Amharic says: For all the Athenians and strangers living there spent their time in nothing but telling and hearing something new. 'all the Athenians and foreigners', 'new things' are v21.

sourceText: ከእናንተ ከባለ ቅኔዎች አንዳንዶች ደግሞ። እኛ ደግሞ ዘመዶቹ ነንና ብለው እንደ ተናገሩ፥ በእርሱ ሕያዋን ነንና እንንቀሳቀሳለን እንኖርማለን።
englishOfProposed: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
note: Amharic says: As some of your poets said, 'We are his offspring', for in him we live and move and exist. 'in him we live and move', 'your poets', 'his offspring' are v28.

sourceText: በመካከላቸውም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እያስተማረ ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ተቀመጠ።
englishOfProposed: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
note: Amharic says: He stayed a year and six months teaching the word of God among them. 'a year and six months', 'teaching the word of God' are v11.

sourceText: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በመንፈስ ታስሬ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እሄዳለሁ፥ በዚያም የሚያገኘኝ ምን እንደ ሆነ አላውቅም፤
englishOfProposed: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
note: Amharic says: And now, behold, bound in the Spirit I go to Jerusalem, not knowing what will meet me there. 'bound in the Spirit', 'going to Jerusalem', 'not knowing what will happen' are v22.

sourceText: ስለዚህ ሦስት ዓመት ሌሊትና ቀን በእንባ እያንዳንዳችሁን ከመገሠጽ እንዳላቋረጥሁ እያሰባችሁ ትጉ።
englishOfProposed: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.
note: Amharic says: Therefore watch, remembering that for three years night and day I did not cease warning each of you with tears. 'three years', 'night and day', 'tears', 'warning each' are v31.

sourceText: በፊት የኤፌሶኑን ጥሮፊሞስን ከእርሱ ጋር በከተማ አይተውት ነበርና ጳውሎስም ወደ መቅደስ ያገባው መስሎአቸው ነው።
englishOfProposed: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
note: Amharic says: For they had earlier seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city and supposed Paul brought him into the temple. 'Trophimus the Ephesian' is v29.

sourceText: ነገር ግን እጅግ እንዳላቆይህ በቸርነትህ በአጭሩ ትሰማን ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ።
englishOfProposed: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.
note: Amharic says: But so as not to detain you further, I beg you of your kindness to hear us briefly. 'not to detain you', 'hear us briefly' are v4.

sourceText: ፊልክስ ግን የመንገዱን ነገር አጥብቆ አውቆአልና። የሻለቃው ሉስዮስ በወረደ ጊዜ ነገራችሁን እቆርጣለሁ ብሎ ወደ ፊት አዘገያቸው።
englishOfProposed: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”
note: Amharic says: But Felix, knowing the Way accurately, put them off, saying: When Lysias the commander comes down I will decide your matter. 'Felix', 'the Way', 'Lysias the commander' are v22.

sourceText: ከመጀመሪያ አንሥቶ በሕዝቤ መካከል በኢየሩሳሌም የሆነውን፥ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምሬ የኖርሁትን ኑሮዬን አይሁድ ሁሉ ያውቃሉ፤
englishOfProposed: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;
note: Amharic says: All the Jews know my manner of life from my youth, which from the beginning was among my people in Jerusalem. 'from my youth', 'among my people in Jerusalem', 'all the Jews know' are v4.

sourceText: ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ከሰማይ የታየኝን ራእይ እምቢ አላልሁም።
englishOfProposed: “Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,
note: Amharic says: Therefore, O King Agrippa, I did not refuse the vision shown me from heaven. 'King Agrippa', 'not disobedient to the heavenly vision' are v19.

sourceText: እንዲህም ብሎ ስለ ራሱ ሲመልስ ፊስጦስ በታላቅ ድምፅ። ጳውሎስ ሆይ፥ አብድሃል እኮ፤ ብዙ ትምህርትህ ወደ እብደት ያዞርሃል አለው።
englishOfProposed: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”
note: Amharic says: As he thus answered for himself, Festus said with a loud voice: Paul, you are mad; your much learning drives you to madness. 'Festus loud voice', 'you are mad', 'much learning' are v24.

sourceText: በእርሱም ስለ ስሙ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል ከእምነት የሚነሣ መታዘዝ እንዲገኝ ጸጋንና ሐዋርያነትን ተቀበልን፤
englishOfProposed: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;
note: Amharic says: Through him, for his name's sake, we received grace and apostleship so that obedience of faith may be found among all the Gentiles. 'grace and apostleship', 'obedience of faith among the Gentiles' are v5.

sourceText: ትጸኑ ዘንድ መንፈሳዊ ስጦታ እንዳካፍላችሁ ላያችሁ እናፍቃለሁና፤
englishOfProposed: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
note: Amharic says: For I long to see you so I may impart to you a spiritual gift so that you may be established. 'long to see you', 'spiritual gift', 'be established' are v11.

sourceText: ጥበበኞች ነን ሲሉ ደንቆሮ ሆኑ፥
englishOfProposed: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
note: Amharic says: Saying they were wise, they became fools. 'claiming to be wise they became fools' is v22.

sourceText: እንግዲህ አንተ ሌላውን የምታስተምር ራስህን አታስተምርምን? አትስረቅ ብለህ የምትሰብክ ትሰርቃለህን?
englishOfProposed: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
note: Amharic says: You then who teach another, do you not teach yourself? You who preach do not steal, do you steal? 'teach others, not yourself', 'preach against stealing, do you steal' are v21.

sourceText: አፍም ሁሉ ይዘጋ ዘንድ ዓለምም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ በታች ይሆን ዘንድ ሕግ የሚናገረው ሁሉ ከሕግ በታች ላሉት እንዲናገር እናውቃለን፤
englishOfProposed: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.
note: Amharic says: We know that whatever the law says it says to those under the law, so every mouth may be stopped and all the world come under God's judgment. 'every mouth stopped', 'under the law', 'whole world accountable to God' are v19.

sourceText: እንግዲህ ሕግን በእምነት እንሽራለንን? አይደለም፤ ሕግን እናጸናለን እንጂ።
englishOfProposed: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
note: Amharic says: Do we then make void the law through faith? No; rather we establish the law. 'nullify the law by faith? no, we uphold the law' is v31.

sourceText: ዘርህ እንዲሁ ሊሆን ነው እንደ ተባለ፥ ተስፋ ባልሆነው ጊዜ የብዙ አሕዛብ አባት እንዲሆን ተስፋ ይዞ አመነ።
englishOfProposed: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
note: Amharic says: As it was said, 'So shall your seed be', in hope against hope he believed, to become father of many nations. 'hope against hope believed', 'so shall your offspring be' are v18; 'father of many nations' is also in v17's quote but the rest is v18.

sourceText: ስለዚህ ደግሞ ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቆጠረለት።
englishOfProposed: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
note: Amharic says: Therefore it was also counted to him as righteousness. 'therefore credited to him as righteousness' is v22.

sourceText: ነገር ግን። ተቈጠረለት የሚለው ቃል ስለ እርሱ ብቻ የተጻፈ አይደለም፥ ስለ እኛም ነው እንጂ፤
englishOfProposed: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
note: Amharic says: But the word 'it was counted to him' was not written for his sake alone, but also for us; 'the word "counted to him" not written for him alone' is v23; the closing 'but for us too' echoes the opening of v24, though none of v24's further content is present.

sourceText: በተሰጠንም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ የእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር በልባችን ስለ ፈሰሰ ተስፋ አያሳፍርም።
englishOfProposed: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
note: Amharic says: Hope does not put to shame, because God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit given us. 'hope does not disappoint', 'love poured into our hearts', 'Holy Spirit given' are v5.

sourceText: በአንዱ ሰው አለመታዘዝ ብዙዎች ኃጢአተኞች እንደ ሆኑ፥ እንዲሁ ደግሞ በአንዱ መታዘዝ ብዙዎች ጻድቃን ይሆናሉ።
englishOfProposed: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
note: Amharic says: As through one man's disobedience many became sinners, so also through one's obedience many will be made righteous. 'disobedience of one man', 'many made sinners/righteous' are v19.

sourceText: ክርስቶስ ከሙታን ተነሥቶ ወደ ፊት እንዳይሞት ሞትም ወደ ፊት እንዳይገዛው እናውቃለንና።
englishOfProposed: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!
note: Amharic says: For we know Christ, having risen from the dead, will not die again, and death will no longer rule over him. 'raised from the dead', 'die no more', 'death no longer has dominion' are v9.

sourceText: ስለ ሥጋችሁ ድካም እንደ ሰው ልማድ እላለሁ። ብልቶቻችሁ ዓመፃ ሊያደርጉ ለርኵስነትና ለዓመፃ ባሪያዎች አድርጋችሁ እንዳቀረባችሁ፥ እንደዚሁ ብልቶቻችሁ ሊቀደሱ ለጽድቅ ባሪያዎች አድርጋችሁ አሁን አቅርቡ።
englishOfProposed: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
note: Amharic says: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. As you presented your members as slaves to impurity and lawlessness, so now present them as slaves to righteousness for holiness. 'human terms', 'weakness of your flesh', 'members as slaves' are v19.

sourceText: እንደ ሥጋ ፈቃድ የሚኖሩ የሥጋን ነገር ያስባሉና፥ እንደ መንፈስ ፈቃድ የሚኖሩ ግን የመንፈስን ነገር ያስባሉ።
englishOfProposed: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
note: Amharic says: Those who live by the flesh think of the things of the flesh, but those who live by the Spirit think of the things of the Spirit. 'according to the flesh / Spirit set their minds' is v5.

sourceText: በሥጋ ዘመዶቼ ስለ ሆኑ ስለ ወንድሞቼ ከክርስቶስ ተለይቼ እኔ ራሴ የተረገምሁ እንድሆን እጸልይ ነበርና።
englishOfProposed: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh
note: Amharic says: For I would pray that I myself be accursed, cut off from Christ, for my brothers, my kinsmen in the flesh. 'accursed from Christ', 'my brothers, kinsmen in the flesh' are v3.

sourceText: የምሕረቱ ዕቃዎችም ከአይሁድ ብቻ አይደሉም፥ ነገር ግን ከአሕዛብ ደግሞ የጠራን እኛ ነን።
englishOfProposed: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
note: Amharic says: The vessels of his mercy are not only from the Jews; we whom he called are also from the Gentiles. 'called not only from the Jews but also the Gentiles' is v24; 'vessels of mercy' is a resumptive link to v23.

sourceText: ኢሳይያስም እንደዚሁ። ጌታ ፀባዖት ዘር ባላስቀረልን እንደ ሰዶም በሆንን ገሞራንም በመሰልን ነበር ብሎ አስቀድሞ ተናገረ።
englishOfProposed: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”
note: Amharic says: And Isaiah likewise foretold: Had the Lord of hosts not left us seed, we would have been as Sodom and like Gomorrah. 'Isaiah foretold', 'Lord of Hosts', 'Sodom', 'Gomorrah' are v29.

sourceText: እስራኤል ግን የጽድቅን ሕግ እየተከተሉ ወደ ሕግ አልደረሱም።
englishOfProposed: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
note: Amharic says: But Israel, pursuing the law of righteousness, did not attain to the law. 'Israel pursuing a law of righteousness has not attained' is v31.

sourceText: የእነርሱ መጣል ለዓለም መታረቅ ከሆነ ከሙታን ከሚመጣ ሕይወት በቀር መመለሳቸው ምን ይሆን?
englishOfProposed: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
note: Amharic says: If their casting away is the reconciliation of the world, what will their return be but life from the dead? 'reconciliation of the world', 'life from the dead' are v15.

sourceText: ስለዚህ ክርስቶስ ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር እንደ ተቀበላችሁ እንዲሁ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተቀባበሉ።
englishOfProposed: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
note: Amharic says: Therefore receive one another as Christ received you for the glory of God. 'accept one another as Christ accepted you', 'glory of God' are v7.

sourceText: ደግሞም። አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ ከሕዝቡ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ ይላል።
englishOfProposed: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”
note: Amharic says: And again: Rejoice, O Gentiles, with his people, it says. 'Rejoice, O Gentiles, with his people' is v10.

sourceText: እንግዲህ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በሚሆን ነገር በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ትምክህት አለኝ።
englishOfProposed: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
note: Amharic says: So I have boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God. 'glory/exult in Christ Jesus in things of God' is v17.

sourceText: እንዲሁም በሌላው ሰው መሠረት ላይ እንዳልሠራ የክርስቶስ ስም በተጠራበት ስፍራ ሳይሆን ወንጌልን ለመስበክ ተጣጣርሁ፤
englishOfProposed: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
note: Amharic says: So I strove to preach the gospel not where Christ's name was named, lest I build on another man's foundation. 'not building on another's foundation', 'where Christ was named' are v20.

sourceText: የሰላምም አምላክ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።
englishOfProposed: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
note: Amharic says: The God of peace be with you all; Amen. 'God of peace be with you all. Amen' is v33.

sourceText: ብቻውን ጥበብ ላለው ለእግዚአብሔር በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።
englishOfProposed: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
note: Amharic says: To God, who alone is wise, be glory forever through Jesus Christ; Amen. 'only wise God', 'glory forever', 'Amen' are v27.

sourceText: እንደዚህ የጌታችንን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን መገለጥ ስትጠባበቁ አንድ የጸጋ ስጦታ እንኳ አይጎድልባችሁም፤
englishOfProposed: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,
note: Amharic says: So that, as you await the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ, you lack not even one gift of grace. 'not lacking any gift', 'awaiting the revelation of our Lord' are v7.

sourceText: የእስጢፋኖስንም ቤተ ሰዎች ደግሞ አጥምቄአለሁ፤ ጨምሬ ሌላ አጥምቄ እንደ ሆነ አላውቅም።
englishOfProposed: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)
note: Amharic says: I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides that I do not know whether I baptized anyone else. 'household of Stephanas', 'don't know if I baptized anyone else' are v16.

sourceText: ሥጋን የለበሰ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዳይመካ።
englishOfProposed: that no flesh should boast before God.
note: Amharic says: So that no flesh may boast before God. 'that no flesh boast before God' is v29.

sourceText: በበሰሉት መካከል ግን ጥበብን እንናገራለን፥ ነገር ግን የዚችን ዓለም ጥበብ አይደለም የሚሻሩትንም የዚችን ዓለም ገዦች ጥበብ አይደለም፤
englishOfProposed: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.
note: Amharic says: Yet we speak wisdom among the mature, not the wisdom of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are passing away. 'among the mature we speak wisdom', 'rulers of this age coming to nothing' are v6.

sourceText: ስለዚህም ማንም በሰው አይመካ። ነገር ሁሉ የእናንተ ነውና፤
englishOfProposed: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
note: Amharic says: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours; 'let no one boast in men', 'all things are yours' are v21.

sourceText: መንፈሱ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ቀን ትድን ዘንድ እንደዚህ ያለው ለሥጋው ጥፋት ለሰይጣን እንዲሰጥ ፍርዴ ነው።
englishOfProposed: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
note: Amharic says: My judgment is that such a one be handed to Satan for the destruction of his flesh, so that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus. 'deliver to Satan', 'destruction of the flesh', 'spirit saved in the day of the Lord' are v5.

sourceText: ከዝሙት ሽሹ። ሰው የሚያደርገው ኃጢአት ሁሉ ከሥጋ ውጭ ነው፤ ዝሙትን የሚሠራ ግን በገዛ ሥጋው ላይ ኃጢአትን ይሠራል።
englishOfProposed: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.
note: Amharic says: Flee sexual immorality. Every sin a man does is outside the body, but he who commits fornication sins against his own body. 'flee fornication', 'sins against his own body' are v18.

sourceText: ሌሎችንም እኔ እላለሁ፥ ጌታም አይደለም፤ ከወንድሞች ወገን ያላመነች ሚስት ያለችው ቢኖር እርስዋም ከእርሱ ጋር ልትቀመጥ ብትስማማ፥ አይተዋት፤
englishOfProposed: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.
note: Amharic says: And to the others I say, not the Lord: if any of the brothers has an unbelieving wife and she agrees to live with him, let him not leave her. 'I say, not the Lord' plus brother with an unbelieving wife willing to stay is unique to v12.

sourceText: እንደ ሌሎቹ ሐዋርያትና እንደ ጌታ ወንድሞች እንደ ኬፋም፥ እኅት ሚስታችንን ይዘን ልንዞር መብት የለንምን?
englishOfProposed: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?
note: Amharic says: Have we no right to go about taking a sister as wife, like the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Cephas? Wife, other apostles, the Lord's brothers and Cephas (ኬፋ) are only in v5.

sourceText: ስለ ባልንጀራህ ሕሊና እንጂ ስለ ገዛ ሕሊናህ አልናገርም። አርነቴ በሌላ ሰው ሕሊና የሚፈርድ Avረ ስለ ምንድር ነው?
englishOfProposed: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
note: The verse is right but one word is garbled ("Avረ", Latin letters). Restoring it needs the correct word from a printed 1962 Amharic Bible, typed into correctedText.

sourceText: እንግዲህ የምትበሉ ወይም የምትጠጡ ብትሆኑ ወይም ማናቸውን ነገር ብታደርጉ ሁሉን ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር አድርጉት።
englishOfProposed: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
note: Amharic says: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do all for the glory of God. Eat, drink, do all to God's glory is v31; no Jews/Greeks or pleasing all men.

sourceText: ዳሩ ግን ማንም ሊከራከር ቢፈቅድ፥ እኛ ወይም የእግዚአብሔር አብያተ ክርስቲያናት እንዲህ ያለ ልማድ የለንም።
englishOfProposed: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.
note: Amharic says: But if anyone wants to be contentious, we have no such custom, nor do the churches of God. Contentious person and 'no such custom, nor the churches of God' match v16 only.

sourceText: አንድም ብልት ቢሣቀይ ብልቶች ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ይሣቀያሉ፤ አንድ ብልትም ቢከበር ብልቶች ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ደስ ይላቸዋል።
englishOfProposed: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
note: Amharic says: If one member suffers, all members suffer with it; if one member is honoured, all members rejoice with it. One member suffering/honoured and all suffering/rejoicing is v26.

sourceText: ይህ የሚበሰብሰው የማይበሰብሰውን ሊለብስ ይህም የሚሞተው የማይሞተውን ሊለብስ ይገባዋልና።
englishOfProposed: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
note: Amharic says: For this perishable must put on the imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality. Perishable putting on imperishable, mortal putting on immortality is v53.

sourceText: ትምክህታችን ይህ ነውና፤ በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ እንጂ በሥጋዊ ጥበብ ሳይሆን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቅድስናና ቅንነት በዚህ ዓለም ይልቁንም በእናንተ ዘንድ እንደኖርን የሕሊናችን ምስክርነት ነው።
englishOfProposed: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.
note: Amharic says: For this is our boast: the testimony of our conscience that we lived in this world, especially toward you, in God's holiness and sincerity, not by fleshly wisdom but by God's grace. Boasting, testimony of conscience, not fleshly wisdom are v12 only.

sourceText: በዚህም ታምኜ፥ ሁለተኛ ጸጋ ታገኙ ዘንድ አስቀድሜ ወደ እናንተ እንድመጣ፥
englishOfProposed: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
note: Amharic says: And trusting in this, I intended to come to you first so that you might receive a second grace, Confidence, coming to you first, and 'second grace/benefit' are v15.

sourceText: ስለዚህም አንታክትም፥ ነገር ግን የውጭው ሰውነታችን ቢጠፋ እንኳ የውስጡ ሰውነታችን ዕለት ዕለት ይታደሳል።
englishOfProposed: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.
note: Amharic says: Therefore we do not lose heart; even if our outer self is perishing, our inner self is renewed day by day. Not fainting, outer self decaying, inner self renewed daily is v16.

sourceText: ታምነናል ይልቁንም ከሥጋ ተለይተን በስደት መኖር በጌታም ዘንድ ማደር ደስ ይለናል።
englishOfProposed: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.
note: Amharic says: We are confident, and we would rather be away from the body and dwell with the Lord. Preferring to be absent from the body and at home with the Lord is v8; v6 has the reverse (at home in body, absent from Lord).

sourceText: ለእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስም ከጣዖት ጋር ምን መጋጠም አለው? እኛ የሕያው እግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ ነንና እንዲሁም እግዚአብሔር ተናገረ እንዲህ ሲል። በእነርሱ እኖራለሁ በመካከላቸውም እመላለሳለሁ፥ አምላካቸውም እሆናለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝቤ ይሆናሉ።
englishOfProposed: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”
note: Amharic says: What agreement has God's temple with idols? For we are the temple of the living God, as God said: I will dwell in them and walk among them, I will be their God and they will be my people. Temple vs idols and 'I will be their God, they my people' are v16; no 'come out' or 'Father/sons and daughters'.

sourceText: ለዘሪ ዘርን ለመብላትም እንጀራን በብዙ የሚሰጥ እርሱም የምትዘሩትን ዘር ይሰጣችኋል ያበረክትላችሁማል፥ የጽድቃችሁንም ፍሬ ያሳድጋል፤
englishOfProposed: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,
note: Amharic says: He who gives seed to the sower and bread for eating will give and multiply the seed you sow and increase the fruit of your righteousness. Seed for the sower, bread for food, fruits of righteousness are v10.

sourceText: ወደ እናንተ እንደማንደርስ አድርገን ከመጠን አናልፍምና፥ የክርስቶስን ወንጌል በመስበክ እስከ እናንተ እንኳ ደርሰናልና፤
englishOfProposed: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
note: Amharic says: For we are not overextending ourselves as though we did not reach you, for we came even as far as you preaching the gospel of Christ. Not overstretching as if not reaching you, and reaching you with Christ's gospel, is v14.

sourceText: በድካም ተሰቅሎአልና፥ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል በሕይወት ይኖራል። እኛ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር እንደክማለንና፥ ነገር ግን ስለ እናንተ በሆነ በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ከእርሱ ጋር በሕይወት እንኖራለን።
englishOfProposed: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.
note: Amharic says: For he was crucified in weakness but lives by God's power; we too are weak with him, but we will live with him by God's power toward you. Crucified in weakness, living by God's power is v4.

sourceText: ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታችንም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን።
englishOfProposed: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
note: Amharic says: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ. The grace-and-peace greeting is v3; no Paul/apostle or Galatia.

sourceText: ከእኔም በፊት ሐዋርያት ወደ ነበሩት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አልወጣሁም፥ ነገር ግን ወደ ዓረብ አገር ሄድሁ እንደ ገናም ወደ ደማስቆ ተመለስሁ።
englishOfProposed: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
note: Amharic says: I did not go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went to Arabia and returned again to Damascus. Jerusalem, Arabia and Damascus are named only in v17.

sourceText: ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ገና እስከ አሁን መገረዝን ብሰብክ እስከ አሁን ድረስ ለምን ያሳድዱኛል? እንኪያስ የመስቀል ዕንቅፋት ተወግዶአል።
englishOfProposed: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
note: Amharic says: But brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the offence of the cross has been removed. Preaching circumcision, persecution and the offence of the cross are v11.

sourceText: ሁሉንም ከእግሩ በታች አስገዛለት ከሁሉ በላይም ራስ እንዲሆን ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰጠው።
englishOfProposed: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
note: Amharic says: He subjected all things under his feet and gave him to the church to be head over all things. All things under his feet and head over all for the church is v22.

sourceText: በእነዚህም ልጆች መካከል እኛ ሁላችን ደግሞ፥ የሥጋችንንና የልቡናችንን ፈቃድ እያደረግን፥ በሥጋችን ምኞት በፊት እንኖር ነበርን እንደ ሌሎቹም ደግሞ ከፍጥረታችን የቁጣ ልጆች ነበርን።
englishOfProposed: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.
note: Amharic says: Among these sons we all also once lived in the lusts of our flesh, doing the will of flesh and mind, and by nature were children of wrath like the others. Lusts of the flesh and 'by nature children of wrath' are v3.

sourceText: ጸጋው በእምነት አድኖአችኋልና፤ ይህም የእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ ነው እንጂ ከእናንተ አይደለም፤
englishOfProposed: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
note: Amharic says: For grace has saved you through faith; and this is the gift of God, not from yourselves. Saved by grace through faith, gift of God, not of yourselves is v8.

sourceText: ጥልንም በመስቀሉ ገድሎ በእርሱ ሁለታቸውን በአንድ አካል ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ያስታርቅ ዘንድ ነው።
englishOfProposed: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.
note: Amharic says: Having killed the hostility by his cross, so that in him he might reconcile both of them to God in one body. Reconciling both in one body through the cross and killing the hostility is v16.

sourceText: እንደ ኃይሉ ሥራ እንደ ተሰጠኝም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ስጦታ መጠንየወንጌል አገልጋይ ሆንሁለት።
englishOfProposed: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.
note: Amharic says: According to the working of his power and the gift of God's grace given to me, I became a minister of the gospel. Becoming a minister of the gospel by the gift of grace through his power is v7.

sourceText: ብዙ ልዩ ልዩ የእግዚአብሔር ጥበብ አሁን በቤተ ክርስቲያን በኩል በሰማያዊ ስፍራ ውስጥ ላሉት አለቆችና ሥልጣናት ትታወቅ ዘንድ፤
englishOfProposed: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,
note: Amharic says: So that the manifold wisdom of God might now be made known through the church to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly places, Manifold wisdom of God made known through the church to heavenly rulers is v10.

sourceText: እንግዲህ በእኛ እንደሚሠራው ኃይል መጠን ከምንለምነው ወይም ከምናስበው ሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ አብልጦ ሊያደርግ ለሚቻለው፥
englishOfProposed: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
note: Amharic says: Now to him who is able to do far more than all we ask or think, according to the power that works in us, 'Able to do far more than we ask or think' by the power at work in us is v20; next verse is the doxology (v21).

sourceText: እንደ ስሕተት ሽንገላ ባለ ተንኮል በሰዎችም ማታለል ምክንያት በትምህርት ነፋስ ሁሉ እየተፍገመገምን ወዲያና ወዲህም እየተንሳፈፍን ሕፃናት መሆን ወደ ፊት አይገባንም፥
englishOfProposed: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
note: Amharic says: We should no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about by every wind of teaching through the trickery and cunning deceit of men. No longer children tossed by every wind of doctrine is v14.

sourceText: ፍሬም ከሌለው ከጨለማ ሥራ ጋር አትተባበሩ፥ ይልቁን ግለጡት እንጂ፥
englishOfProposed: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
note: Amharic says: Do not take part in the fruitless works of darkness, but rather expose them. No fellowship with fruitless works of darkness, rather expose them, is v11.

sourceText: እድፈት ወይም የፊት መጨማደድ ወይም እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ሳይሆንባት ቅድስትና ያለ ነውር ትሆን ዘንድ ክብርት የሆነችን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ለራሱ እንዲያቀርብ ፈለገ።
englishOfProposed: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.
note: Amharic says: He wanted to present to himself a glorious church, without spot or wrinkle or any such thing, so that she would be holy and blameless. Glorious church without spot or wrinkle, holy and blameless, is v27.

sourceText: ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል ከሚስቱም ጋር ይተባበራል ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ።
englishOfProposed: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”
note: Amharic says: Therefore a man will leave his father and mother and cleave to his wife, and the two will become one flesh. Leaving father and mother, one flesh, is the Genesis quote in v31.

sourceText: እናንተም አባቶች ሆይ፥ ልጆቻችሁን በጌታ ምክርና በተግሣጽ አሳድጉአቸው እንጂ አታስቆጡአቸው።
englishOfProposed: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
note: Amharic says: And you fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in the counsel and discipline of the Lord. Fathers not provoking children, raising them in the Lord's discipline, is v4.

sourceText: በሁሉም ላይ ጨምራችሁ የሚንበለበሉትን የክፉውን ፍላጻዎች ሁሉ ልታጠፉ የምትችሉበትን የእምነትን ጋሻ አንሡ፤
englishOfProposed: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
note: Amharic says: Above all, take up the shield of faith with which you can quench all the flaming arrows of the evil one. Shield of faith quenching the flaming arrows is v16.

sourceText: በእናንተ መልካምን ሥራ የጀመረው እስከ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ቀን ድረስ እንዲፈጽመው ይህን ተረድቼአለሁና፤
englishOfProposed: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
note: Amharic says: For I am convinced of this, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ. He who began a good work will complete it until the day of Christ is v6.

sourceText: ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ይህ የደረሰብኝ በእውነት ወንጌልን ለማስፋት እንደ ሆነ ታውቁ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ።
englishOfProposed: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,
note: Amharic says: But brothers, I want you to know that what has happened to me has truly served to advance the gospel. What happened to me advancing the gospel is v12.

sourceText: ይሁን እንጂ፥ መጥቼ ባያችሁ ወይም ብርቅ፥ በአንድ ልብ ስለ ወንጌል ሃይማኖት አብራችሁ እየተጋደላችሁ፥ በአንድ መንፈስ እንድትቆሙ ስለ ኑሮአችሁ እሰማ ዘንድ፥ ለክርስቶስ ወንጌል እንደሚገባ ኑሩ።
englishOfProposed: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
note: Amharic says: Only live worthily of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear that you stand in one spirit, striving together with one mind for the faith of the gospel. Conduct worthy of the gospel, whether I come or am absent, standing in one spirit is v27.

sourceText: በእነርሱም መካከል የሕይወትን ቃል እያቀረባችሁ በዓለም እንደ ብርሃን ትታያላችሁ፥ ስለዚህም በከንቱ እንዳልሮጥሁ በከንቱም እንዳልደከምሁ በክርስቶስ ቀን የምመካበት ይሆንልኛል።
englishOfProposed: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
note: Amharic says: Among them, holding forth the word of life, you appear as lights in the world, so that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labour in vain. Word of life and not running/labouring in vain are v16, but 'as lights in the world' is in English v15 (likely moved by Amharic word order). The text seems to hold words from more than one verse, so putting it under one number may be wrong; leaving the range unavailable may be best.

sourceText: አሁን እንዳገኘሁ ወይም አሁን ፍጹም እንደ ሆንሁ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ስለ እርሱ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ የተያዝሁበትን ያን ደግሞ እይዛለሁ ብዬ እፈጥናለሁ።
englishOfProposed: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
note: Amharic says: Not that I have already obtained or am already perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus. Not already obtained or perfect, pressing on to lay hold, is v12.

sourceText: ይህም በዓለም ሁሉ ደግሞ እንዳለ ወደ እናንተ ደርሶአል፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ጸጋ በእውነት ከሰማችሁበትና ካወቃችሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ፥ በእናንተ ደግሞ እንዳለ እንዲህ በዓለም ፍሬ ያፈራል ያድግማል።
englishOfProposed: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
note: Amharic says: It has come to you as it is in all the world, and since the day you heard and truly knew the grace of God it bears fruit and grows in the world as it does among you. Gospel come to you, bearing fruit and growing in all the world since you knew God's grace, is v6.

sourceText: ከደስታም ጋር በሁሉ ለመጽናትና ለመታገሥ እንደ ክብሩ ጉልበት መጠን በኃይል ሁሉ እየበረታችሁ፥ በቅዱሳንም ርስት በብርሃን እንድንካፈል ያበቃንን አብን እያመሰገናችሁ፥ በነገር ሁሉ ደስ ልታሰኙ ለጌታ እንደሚገባ ትመላለሱ ዘንድ እንለምናለን።
englishOfProposed: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,
note: Amharic says: We pray that you may walk worthily of the Lord, pleasing him in everything, being strengthened with all power according to his glorious might for all endurance and patience with joy, giving thanks to the Father who qualified us to share in the inheritance of the saints in light. Contains v10 (walk worthy, please him), all of v11 (strengthened, endurance, patience, joy) and all of v12 (thanks to the Father, inheritance in light); it is a merged rendering, so no single verse fits. The text seems to hold words from more than one verse, so putting it under one number may be wrong; leaving the range unavailable may be best. A second check proposed verse 11 instead.

sourceText: እርሱም ከሁሉ በፊት ነው ሁሉም በእርሱ ተጋጥሞአል።
englishOfProposed: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
note: Amharic says: He is before all things, and all things hold together in him. Before all things, all things hold together in him, is v17; next verse is v18 (head of the body).

sourceText: ይህም፥ ተመሥርታችሁና ተደላድላችሁ ከሰማችሁትም ከወንጌል ተስፋ ሳትናወጡ፥ በሃይማኖት ጸንታችሁ ብትኖሩ ይሆናል። ያም ወንጌል ከሰማይ በታች ባለው ፍጥረት ሁሉ ዘንድ የተሰበከ ነው፥ እኔም ጳውሎስ የእርሱ አገልጋይ ሆንሁ።
englishOfProposed: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
note: Amharic says: This will be so if you continue in the faith, grounded and settled, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which was preached to all creation under heaven, of which I Paul became a minister. Continuing in the faith, gospel preached to every creature, 'I Paul became its minister' is v23.

sourceText: እንደ ሰው ሥርዓትና ትምህርት። አትያዝ፥ አትቅመስ፥ አትንካ ለሚሉት ትእዛዛት በዓለም እንደምትኖሩ ስለ ምን ትገዛላችሁ? እነዚህ ሁሉ በመደረግ ሊጠፉ ተወስነዋልና።
englishOfProposed: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
note: Amharic says: According to human commands and teachings, 'Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch': why, as though living in the world, do you submit to such rules? All these are destined to perish with use. Has the quote of v21, 'why submit as though living in the world' from v20, and 'perish with use / human commands' from v22, so it is a merged rendering of the range (missing only v20's 'if you died with Christ'). The text seems to hold words from more than one verse, so putting it under one number may be wrong; leaving the range unavailable may be best.

sourceText: ከእናንተ የሆነ የክርስቶስ ባሪያ ኤጳፍራ ሰላምታ ያቀርብላችኋል። በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ሁሉ ተረድታችሁና ፍጹማን ሆናችሁ እንድትቆሙ፥ ሁልጊዜ ስለ እናንተ በጸሎቱ ይጋደላል።
englishOfProposed: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
note: Amharic says: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, greets you; he always strives for you in his prayers that you may stand perfect and fully assured in all the will of God. Epaphras's greeting and his wrestling in prayer are v12.

sourceText: በእግዚአብሔር የምትወደዱ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እንደ ተመረጣችሁ አውቀናልና።
englishOfProposed: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
note: Amharic says: For we know, brothers loved by God, that you have been chosen. Brothers beloved by God, knowing your election, is v4.

sourceText: ከእናንተ ወጥቶ የጌታ ቃል በመቄዶንያና በአካይያ ብቻ አልተሰማምና፥ ነገር ግን ምንም እንድንናገር እስከማያስፈልግ ድረስ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የሚሆን እምነታችሁ በሁሉ ስፍራ ተወርቶአል።
englishOfProposed: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.
note: Amharic says: For from you the word of the Lord was heard not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has been spread everywhere, so that we need say nothing. Word sounding out in Macedonia and Achaia, faith known everywhere, no need to speak is v8.

sourceText: ስለዚህም የመልእክትን ቃል እርሱም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ከእኛ በተቀበላችሁ ጊዜ፥ በእውነት እንዳለ በእናንተ በምታምኑ ደግሞ እንደሚሠራ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል እንጂ እንደ ሰው ቃል አድርጋችሁ ስላልተቀበላችሁት፥ እኛ ደግሞ እግዚአብሔርን ሳናቋርጥ እናመሰግናለን።
englishOfProposed: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.
note: Amharic says: Therefore we also thank God without ceasing, because when you received the word of God from us, you accepted it not as the word of men but as God's word, as it truly is, which works in you who believe. Receiving the word as God's word not men's, which works in believers, is v13.

sourceText: አምላካችንና አባታችን ራሱ ጌታችንም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ወደ እናንተ መንገዳችንን ያቅና፤
englishOfProposed: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
note: Amharic says: May our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus Christ direct our way to you. God the Father and the Lord Jesus directing our way to you is v11.

sourceText: አስቀድመን ደግሞ እንዳልናችሁና እንደ መሰከርንላችሁ፥ ጌታ ስለዚህ ነገር ሁሉ የሚበቀል ነውና ማንም በዚህ ነገር አይተላለፍ ወንድሙንም አያታልል።
englishOfProposed: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
note: Amharic says: As we told you before and testified, let no one transgress in this matter or wrong his brother, for the Lord avenges all these things. Not wronging a brother, the Lord as avenger, as we warned before, is v6.

sourceText: ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ተስፋ እንደሌላቸው እንደ ሌሎች ደግሞ እንዳታዝኑ፥ አንቀላፍተው ስላሉቱ ታውቁ ዘንድ እንወዳለን።
englishOfProposed: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.
note: Amharic says: But brothers, we want you to know about those who are asleep, so that you do not grieve like others who have no hope. Those asleep and not grieving like those without hope is v13.

sourceText: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እንመክራችኋለን፤ ያለ ሥርዓት የሚሄዱትን ገሥጹአቸው፤ ድፍረት የሌላቸውን አጽኑአቸው፤ ለደካሞች ትጉላቸው፤ ሰውን ሁሉ ታገሡ።
englishOfProposed: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
note: Amharic says: Brothers, we exhort you: admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, be patient with everyone. Admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak is v14.

sourceText: መንፈስን አታጥፉ፤
englishOfProposed: Don’t quench the Spirit.
note: Amharic says: Do not quench the Spirit. 'Do not quench the Spirit' is v19.

sourceText: ከማናቸውም ዓይነት ክፉ ነገር ራቁ።
englishOfProposed: Abstain from every form of evil.
note: Amharic says: Keep away from every kind of evil. Abstaining from every form of evil is v22.

sourceText: እግዚአብሔርን የማያውቁትን፥ ለጌታችንም ለኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ወንጌል የማይታዘዙትን ይበቀላል፤
englishOfProposed: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
