note: Amharic says: He will take vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ. Vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel is v8.

sourceText: ማንም በማናቸውም መንገድ አያስታችሁ፤ ክህደቱ አስቀድሞ ሳይመጣና የዓመፅ ሰው እርሱም የጥፋት ልጅ ሳይገለጥ፥ አይደርስምና።
englishOfProposed: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.
note: Amharic says: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come unless the apostasy comes first and the man of lawlessness, the son of destruction, is revealed. Let no one deceive you, the apostasy and the man of lawlessness are v3.

sourceText: እኛ ግን፥ በጌታ የተወደዳችሁ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ሁልጊዜ ስለ እናንተ እግዚአብሔርን ልናመሰግን ግድ አለብን፥ እግዚአብሔር በመንፈስ መቀደስ እውነትንም በማመን ለመዳን እንደ በኵራት መርጦአችኋልና፤
englishOfProposed: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,
note: Amharic says: But we must always thank God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits for salvation through sanctification by the Spirit and belief in the truth. Thanking God, brothers beloved by the Lord, chosen for salvation by the Spirit's sanctification, is v13.

sourceText: እንግዲያስ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ጸንታችሁ ቁሙ፥ በቃላችንም ቢሆን ወይም በመልእክታችን የተማራችሁትን ወግ ያዙ።
englishOfProposed: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.
note: Amharic says: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions you were taught, whether by our word or by our letter. Stand firm and hold the traditions taught by word or letter is v15.

sourceText: ነገር ግን የሚያጸናችሁ ከክፉውም የሚጠብቃችሁ ጌታ የታመነ ነው።
englishOfProposed: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
note: Amharic says: But the Lord who strengthens you and guards you from the evil one is faithful. The Lord is faithful, establishing and guarding from the evil one, is v3.

sourceText: የትእዛዝ ፍጻሜ ግን ከንጹሕ ልብና ከበጎ ሕሊና ግብዝነትም ከሌለበት እምነት የሚወጣ ፍቅር ነው፤
englishOfProposed: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,
note: Amharic says: But the goal of the commandment is love that comes from a pure heart, a good conscience and sincere faith. Love from a pure heart, good conscience and unfeigned faith is v5.

sourceText: ነገር ግን ሰው እንደሚገባ ቢሰራበት ሕግ መልካም እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን፤
englishOfProposed: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,
note: Amharic says: But we know that the law is good if one uses it properly. The law is good if used lawfully is v8.

sourceText: ለአገልግሎቱ ሾሞኝ ታማኝ አድርጎ ስለ ቈጠረኝ፥ ኃይል የሰጠኝን ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን ጌታችንን አመሰግናለሁ፤
englishOfProposed: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,
note: Amharic says: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord who gave me strength, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to his service. Thanking Christ who strengthened me and counted me faithful for ministry is v12.

sourceText: አንድ እግዚአብሔር አለና፥ በእግዚአብሔርና በሰውም መካከል ያለው መካከለኛው ደግሞ አንድ አለ፥ እርሱም ሰው የሆነ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ነው፤
englishOfProposed: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
note: Amharic says: For there is one God, and there is also one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus. One God and one mediator, the man Christ Jesus, is v5.

sourceText: ሴት በነገር ሁሉ እየተገዛች በዝግታ ትማር፤
englishOfProposed: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.
note: Amharic says: Let a woman learn in quietness, submitting in everything. A woman learning in quietness with full submission is v11.

sourceText: እነዚህ ውሸተኞች መጋባትን ይከለክላሉ፥ አምነውም እውነትን የሚያውቁ ከምስጋና ጋር ይቀበሉ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ከፈጠረው መብል እንዲርቁ ያዝዛሉ።
englishOfProposed: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
note: Amharic says: These liars forbid marriage and command abstaining from foods God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth. Forbidding marriage and foods to be received with thanksgiving is v3; only the subject 'these liars' echoes v2.

sourceText: እስክመጣ ድረስ ለማንበብና ለመምከር ለማስተማርም ተጠንቀቅ።
englishOfProposed: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
note: Amharic says: Until I come, attend to reading, exhortation and teaching. 'Until I come', reading, exhortation and teaching are v13.

sourceText: በእውነት ባልቴቶች የሆኑትን ባልቴቶች አክብር።
englishOfProposed: Honor widows who are widows indeed.
note: Amharic says: Honour widows who are truly widows. Honouring true widows is v3.

sourceText: ኑሮዬ ይበቃኛል ለሚለው ግን እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል እጅግ ማትረፊያ ነው፤
englishOfProposed: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
note: Amharic says: But for one who says 'my living is enough for me', godliness is great gain. Godliness with contentment as great gain is v6; v5 mentions godliness as gain but negatively.

sourceText: ጢሞቴዎስ ሆይ፥ በውሸት እውቀት ከተባለ ለዓለም ከሚመች ከከንቱ መለፍለፍና መከራከር እየራቅህ፥ የተሰጠህን አደራ ጠብቅ፤
englishOfProposed: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,
note: Amharic says: O Timothy, keeping away from the worldly empty babbling and disputes of what is falsely called knowledge, guard what was entrusted to you; Vocative 'Timothy', 'falsely called knowledge' and 'guard the deposit' are all v20.

sourceText: ስለዚህም ምክንያት ይህን መከራ ደግሞ ተቀብዬአለሁ፥ ነገር ግን አላፍርበትም፤ ያመንሁትን አውቃለሁና፥ የሰጠሁትንም አደራ እስከዚያ ቀን ድረስ ሊጠብቅ እንዲችል ተረድቼአለሁ።
englishOfProposed: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.
note: Amharic says: For this reason I also suffer this affliction, but I am not ashamed of it; for I know whom I have believed, and I am persuaded he is able to guard what I entrusted until that day. 'I suffer', 'not ashamed', 'I know whom I believed', 'until that day' match v12 only.

sourceText: የጌታም ባሪያ ለሰው ሁሉ ገር ለማስተማርም የሚበቃ ለትዕግሥትም የሚጸና ሊሆን እንጂ ሊጣላ አይገባውም።
englishOfProposed: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,
note: Amharic says: The Lord's servant must be gentle to all, able to teach, patient, and must not quarrel. 'Lord's servant', 'not quarrel', 'gentle to all, able to teach' is v24.

sourceText: ኢያኔስና ኢያንበሬስም ሙሴን እንደ ተቃወሙት፥ እንዲሁ እነዚህ ደግሞ አእምሮአቸው የጠፋባቸው ስለ እምነትም የተጣሉ ሰዎች ሆነው፥ እውነትን ይቃወማሉ።
englishOfProposed: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.
note: Amharic says: As Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these too, men of corrupted mind and rejected concerning the faith, oppose the truth. Names Jannes, Jambres and Moses appear only in v8.

sourceText: ከሕፃንነትህም ጀምረህ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን በማመን፥ መዳን የሚገኝበትን ጥበብ ሊሰጡህ የሚችሉትን ቅዱሳን መጻሕፍትን አውቀሃል።
englishOfProposed: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
note: Amharic says: From childhood you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to give you wisdom for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus. 'From childhood', 'holy Scriptures', 'wise for salvation' match v15.

sourceText: በዘመኑም ጊዜ፥ መድኃኒታችን እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ፥ ለእኔ አደራ በተሰጠኝ ስብከት ቃሉን ገለጠ፤
englishOfProposed: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
note: Amharic says: In his own time, as God our Savior commanded, he revealed his word in the preaching entrusted to me; 'In his time revealed his word', 'entrusted to me', 'command of God our Savior' are v3.

sourceText: ሁሉ ለንጹሖች ንጹሕ ነው፤ ለርኵሳንና ለማያምኑ ግን ንጹሕ የሆነ ምንም የለም፥ ነገር ግን አእምሮአቸውም ሕሊናቸውም ረክሶአል።
englishOfProposed: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
note: Amharic says: To the pure all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure, but both their mind and conscience are defiled. 'To the pure all things are pure' and defiled mind and conscience are v15.

sourceText: ጎበዞችም እንዲሁ ራሳቸውን እንዲገዙ ምከራቸው።
englishOfProposed: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
note: Amharic says: Likewise exhort the young men to be self-controlled. 'Young men ... likewise ... self-controlled' is v6.

sourceText: ሰዎችን ሁሉ የሚያድን የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ተገልጦአልና፤
englishOfProposed: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
note: Amharic says: For the grace of God that saves all people has appeared; 'Grace of God appeared, bringing salvation to all' is v11.

sourceText: መድኃኒታችንም ከዓመፅ ሁሉ እንዲቤዠን፥ መልካሙንም ለማድረግ የሚቀናውን ገንዘቡም የሚሆነውን ሕዝብ ለራሱ እንዲያነጻ፥ ስለ እኛ ነፍሱን ሰጥቶአል።
englishOfProposed: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
note: Amharic says: Our Savior gave himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and purify for himself a people of his own, zealous to do good. 'Gave himself for us', 'redeem from all iniquity', 'purify a people zealous for good works' is v14.

sourceText: እኛ ደግሞ አስቀድመን የማናስተውል ነበርንና፤ የማንታዘዝ፥ የምንስት፥ ለምኞትና ለልዩ ልዩ ተድላ እንደ ባሪያዎች የምንገዛ፥ በክፋትና በምቀኝነት የምንኖር፥ የምንጣላ፥ እርስ በርሳችን የምንጠላላ ነበርን።
englishOfProposed: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
note: Amharic says: For we too were once foolish, disobedient, deceived, enslaved to lusts and various pleasures, living in malice and envy, quarrelsome, hating one another. 'We too were once foolish, disobedient ... hating one another' is v3.

sourceText: ቃሉ የታመነ ነው። እግዚአብሔርንም የሚያምኑት በመልካም ሥራ በጥንቃቄ እንዲጸኑ፥ እነዚህን አስረግጠህ እንድትናገር እፈቅዳለሁ። ይህ መልካምና ለሰዎች የሚጠቅም ነው፤
englishOfProposed: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
note: Amharic says: The saying is trustworthy. I want you to insist on these things, so that those who believe God are careful to maintain good works. This is good and profitable for people; 'The saying is faithful', 'careful to maintain good works', 'good and profitable' is v8.

sourceText: አርጢሞንን ወይም ቲኪቆስን ወደ አንተ ስልክ፥ ወደ ኒቆጵልዮን ወደ እኔ እንድትመጣ ትጋ፤ በዚያ ልከርም ቈርጬአለሁና።
englishOfProposed: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
note: Amharic says: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, hurry to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to winter there. Names Artemas, Tychicus and Nicopolis appear only in v12.

sourceText: የእምነትህም ኅብረት፥ በእኛ ዘንድ ያለውን በጎ ነገር ሁሉ በማወቅ፥ ለክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ፍሬ እንዲያፈራ እለምናለሁ፤
englishOfProposed: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
note: Amharic says: I pray that the fellowship of your faith may bear fruit for Christ Jesus through knowing every good thing that is in us; 'Fellowship of your faith', 'knowledge of every good thing in us' is v6.

sourceText: እርሱን እልከዋለሁ፤
englishOfProposed: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
note: Amharic says: I am sending him back; 'I send him' is the opening of v12 (the next Amharic verse carries 'receive him as my heart').

sourceText: ስለዚህም ምክንያት። ስምህን ለወንድሞቼ እነግራቸዋለሁ በማኅበርም መካከል በዜማ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እኔ በእርሱ እታመናለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እነሆኝ እኔን እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝንም ልጆች ሲል ወንድሞች ብሎ ሊጠራቸው አያፍርም።
englishOfProposed: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”
note: Amharic says: For this reason, saying 'I will declare your name to my brothers, in the assembly I will sing your praise', and again 'I will trust in him', and again 'Here am I and the children God gave me', he is not ashamed to call them brothers. Contains v11 ('not ashamed to call them brothers'), the v12 psalm quote and both v13 quotes, so it covers the whole range. The text seems to hold words from more than one verse, so putting it under one number may be wrong; leaving the range unavailable may be best.

sourceText: የአብርሃምን ዘር ይዞአል እንጂ የያዘው የመላእክትን አይደለም።
englishOfProposed: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.
note: Amharic says: He took hold of the seed of Abraham, not that of angels. 'Seed of Abraham' versus 'angels' is v16.

sourceText: ስለዚህ ያን ትውልድ ተቆጥቼ። ዘወትር በልባቸው ይስታሉ መንገዴን ግን አላወቁም አልሁ፤
englishOfProposed: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’
note: Amharic says: Therefore I was angry with that generation and said, 'They always go astray in their heart, and they did not know my ways'; 'Angry with that generation', 'err in their heart', 'did not know my ways' is v10.

sourceText: ስለ እርሱም የምንናገረው ብዙ ነገር አለን፥ ጆሮቻችሁም ስለ ፈዘዙ በቃል ልንተረጕመው ጭንቅ ነው።
englishOfProposed: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
note: Amharic says: About him we have much to say, and it is hard to explain because your ears have become dull. 'Much to say', 'hard to interpret', 'dull of hearing' is v11.

sourceText: እግዚአብሔርም ቢፈቅድ ይህን እናደርጋለን።
englishOfProposed: This will we do, if God permits.
note: Amharic says: And this we will do if God permits. 'If God permits, we will do this' is v3.

sourceText: እንዲሁም እርሱ ከታገሰ በኋላ ተስፋውን አገኘ።
englishOfProposed: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
note: Amharic says: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise. 'Having patiently endured he obtained the promise' is v15.

sourceText: ይህም ተስፋ እንደ ነፍስ መልሕቅ አለን እርሱም እርግጥና ጽኑ የሆነ ወደ መጋረጃውም ውስጥ የገባ ነው፤
englishOfProposed: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,
note: Amharic says: We have this hope as an anchor of the soul, sure and steadfast, which enters inside the veil; 'Anchor of the soul', 'sure and steadfast', 'within the veil' is v19.

sourceText: አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ብሎ ይመሰክራልና።
englishOfProposed: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
note: Amharic says: For he testifies, 'You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.' 'It is testified: You are a priest forever after Melchizedek' is v17.

sourceText: እንዲሁ ኢየሱስ ለሚሻል ኪዳን ዋስ ሆኖአል።
englishOfProposed: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
note: Amharic says: So Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant. 'Jesus guarantee of a better covenant' is v22.

sourceText: ነገር ግን ክርስቶስ ይመጣ ዘንድ ላለው መልካም ነገር ሊቀ ካህናት ሆኖ፥ በምትበልጠውና በምትሻለው በእጆችም ባልተሠራች ማለት ለዚህ ፍጥረት ባልሆነች ድንኳን፥
englishOfProposed: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
note: Amharic says: But Christ, as high priest of the good things to come, through the greater and more perfect tent not made with hands, that is, not of this creation, 'Christ high priest of good things to come', 'tabernacle not made with hands' is v11.

sourceText: እንዲሁም በድንኳኒቱና በማገልገያው ዕቃ ሁሉ ደምን ረጨ።
englishOfProposed: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.
note: Amharic says: Likewise he sprinkled blood on the tent and on all the vessels of service. 'Sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels with blood' is v21.

sourceText: ብሎ ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንና ዓመጻቸውንም ደግሜ አላስብም ይላል።
englishOfProposed: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”
note: Amharic says: After he has said this, he says, 'I will not remember their sins and their iniquities again.' 'I will remember their sins and iniquities no more' is v17; the lead-in 'after saying ... he says' echoes the frame split across v15-16.

sourceText: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ላይ የሆነ ታላቅ ካህን ስላለን፥
englishOfProposed: and having a great priest over God’s house,
note: Amharic says: and since we have a great priest over the house of God, 'Great priest over God's house' is v21.

sourceText: የሚበልጥና ለዘወትር የሚኖር ገንዘብ በሰማይ ራሳችሁ እንዳላችሁ አውቃችሁ፥ በእስራቴ ራራችሁልኝ የገንዘባችሁንም ንጥቂያ በደስታ ተቀበላችሁ።
englishOfProposed: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.
note: Amharic says: Knowing you have for yourselves a better and lasting possession in heaven, you had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your goods. 'Compassion on me in my chains', 'plundering of possessions', 'better possession in heaven' is v34.

sourceText: እግዚአብሔር ከሙታን እንኳ ሊያስነሣው እንዲቻለው አስቦአልና፥ ከዚያም ደግሞ በምሳሌ አገኘው።
englishOfProposed: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
note: Amharic says: For he reasoned that God was able to raise him even from the dead, and from there figuratively he received him back. 'God able to raise from the dead', 'received him back figuratively' is v19.

sourceText: የንጉሡን ቍጣ ሳይፈራ የግብፅን አገር የተወ በእምነት ነበር፤ የማይታየውን እንደሚያየው አድርጎ ጸንቶአልና።
englishOfProposed: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
note: Amharic says: By faith he left the land of Egypt, not fearing the king's wrath; for he endured as seeing the one who is invisible. 'Left Egypt', 'not fearing the wrath of the king', 'seeing him who is invisible' is v27.

sourceText: ዓለም አልተገባቸውምና በምድረ በዳና በተራራ፥ በዋሻና በምድር ጕድጓድ ተቅበዘበዙ።
englishOfProposed: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
note: Amharic says: The world was not worthy of them; they wandered in deserts and mountains, in caves and holes in the ground. 'World not worthy', 'deserts, mountains, caves, holes of the earth' is v38.

sourceText: በነፍሳችሁ ዝላችሁ እንዳትደክሙ፥ ከኃጢአተኞች በደረሰበት እንዲህ ባለ መቃወም የጸናውን አስቡ።
englishOfProposed: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
note: Amharic says: Consider him who endured such opposition from sinners, so that you do not grow weary and faint in your souls. 'Consider him who endured contradiction of sinners', 'not weary, fainting in your souls' is v3.

sourceText: ለመቀጣት ታገሡ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ልጆች ያደርግላችኋልና፤ አባቱ የማይቀጣው ልጅ ማን ነው?
englishOfProposed: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
note: Amharic says: Endure for discipline; God is treating you as children; for what son is there whom his father does not discipline? 'Endure for discipline', 'deals with you as children', 'what son whom father does not discipline' is v7.

sourceText: ከእነርሱ ጋር እንደ ታሰረ ሆናችሁ እስሮችን አስቡ፥ የተጨነቁትንም ራሳችሁ ደግሞ በሥጋ እንዳለ ሆናችሁ አስቡ።
englishOfProposed: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
note: Amharic says: Remember the prisoners as if bound with them, and the afflicted as if you yourselves were in the body. 'Remember prisoners as bound with them', 'ill-treated ... in the body' is v3.

sourceText: ትዕግሥትም ምንም የሚጎድላችሁ ሳይኖር ፍጹማንና ምሉዓን ትሆኑ ዘንድ ሥራውን ይፈጽም።
englishOfProposed: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
note: Amharic says: Let endurance finish its work, so that you may be perfect and complete, lacking nothing. 'Let patience have its work, perfect and complete, lacking nothing' is v4.

sourceText: ፀሐይ ከትኵሳት ጋር ይወጣልና፥ ሣርንም ያጠወልጋልና፥ አበባውም ይረግፋልና፥ የመልኩም ውበት ይጠፋልና፤ እንዲሁ ደግሞ ባለ ጠጋው በመንገዱ ይዝላል።
englishOfProposed: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.
note: Amharic says: For the sun rises with burning heat and withers the grass, its flower falls and the beauty of its appearance perishes; so too the rich man will fade away in his ways. 'Sun rises with scorching heat, withers grass ... rich man fades in his pursuits' is v11.

sourceText: ለእናንተም ስለሚሰጠው ጸጋ ትንቢት የተናገሩት ነቢያት ስለዚህ መዳን ተግተው እየፈለጉ መረመሩት፤
englishOfProposed: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
note: Amharic says: The prophets who prophesied about the grace to be given to you searched and inquired diligently about this salvation; 'Prophets searched diligently about this salvation', 'grace that would come to you' is v10.

sourceText: ለሰው ፊትም ሳያደላ በእያንዳንዱ ላይ እንደ ሥራው የሚፈርደውን አባት ብላችሁ ብትጠሩ በእንግድነታችሁ ዘመን በፍርሃት ኑሩ።
englishOfProposed: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,
note: Amharic says: If you call on as Father the one who judges each impartially according to his work, live in fear during your time as sojourners. 'Call on him as Father', 'judges without partiality according to work', 'time of sojourning in fear' is v17.

sourceText: ለእውነት እየታዘዛችሁ ግብዝነት ለሌለበት ለወንድማማች መዋደደ ነፍሳችሁን አንጽታችሁ እርስ በርሳችሁ ከልባችሁ አጥብቃችሁ ተዋደዱ።
englishOfProposed: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,
note: Amharic says: Having purified your souls by obeying the truth for sincere brotherly love, love one another earnestly from the heart. 'Purified souls in obedience to the truth', 'unfeigned brotherly love', 'love one another from the heart' is v22.

sourceText: በሰውም ወደ ተጣለ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ግን ወደ ተመረጠና ክቡር ወደ ሆነው ወደ ሕያው ድንጋይ ወደ እርሱ እየቀረባችሁ፥
englishOfProposed: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
note: Amharic says: coming to him, the living stone rejected by men but chosen and precious with God, 'Living stone rejected by men, chosen by God, precious' is v4.

sourceText: ለእናንተም ጠጕርን በመሸረብና ወርቅን በማንጠልጠል ወይም ልብስን በመጎናጸፍ በውጭ የሆነ ሽልማት አይሁንላችሁ፥
englishOfProposed: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,
note: Amharic says: Let your adornment not be the outward kind, braiding hair, hanging on gold, or putting on clothes, Braided hair, gold and clothing as outward adornment is v3.

sourceText: የአሕዛብን ፈቃድ ያደረጋችሁበት በመዳራትና በሥጋ ምኞትም በስካርም በዘፈንም ያለ ልክም በመጠጣት ነውርም ባለበት በጣዖት ማምለክ የተመላለሳችሁበት ያለፈው ዘመን ይበቃልና።
englishOfProposed: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
note: Amharic says: For the past time is enough in which you did the will of the Gentiles, walking in debauchery, lusts, drunkenness, revelry, excessive drinking and shameful idolatry. 'Past time enough doing the will of the Gentiles' plus the vice list is v3.

sourceText: ስለ ክፉ ምኞት በዓለም ካለው ጥፋት አምልጣችሁ ከመለኮት ባሕርይ ተካፋዮች በተስፋ ቃል እንድትሆኑ፥ በእነዚያ ክብርና በጎነት የተከበረና እጅግ ታላቅ የሆነ ተስፋን ሰጠን።
englishOfProposed: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
note: Amharic says: Through that glory and virtue he gave us precious and exceedingly great promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world due to evil desire. 'Great promises', 'partakers of divine nature', 'escaped corruption in the world by lust' is v4; 'glory and virtue' is a back-reference to v3.

sourceText: ዳሩ ግን መላእክት በኃይልና በብርታት ከእነርሱ ይልቅ ምንም ቢበልጡ በጌታ ፊት በእነርሱ ላይ የስድብን ፍርድ አያመጡም።
englishOfProposed: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.
note: Amharic says: But angels, though greater in might and power, do not bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord. 'Angels greater in might and power ... no slanderous judgment before the Lord' is v11.

sourceText: በመጨረሻው ዘመን እንደ ራሳቸው ምኞት የሚመላለሱ ዘባቾች በመዘበት እንዲመጡ ይህን በፊት እወቁ፤
englishOfProposed: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
note: Amharic says: Know this first, that in the last days scoffers will come with scoffing, walking according to their own desires; 'Knowing this first', 'last days', 'mockers walking after their own lusts' is v3.

sourceText: ነገር ግን ጽድቅ የሚኖርባትን አዲስ ሰማይና አዲስ ምድር እንደ ተስፋ ቃሉ እንጠብቃለን።
englishOfProposed: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
note: Amharic says: But according to his promise we wait for a new heaven and a new earth in which righteousness dwells. 'New heavens and new earth where righteousness dwells, according to his promise' is v13.

sourceText: ዓለሙም ምኞቱም ያልፋሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
englishOfProposed: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
note: Amharic says: The world and its desire pass away, but whoever does the will of God abides forever. 'World passes away with its lusts; who does God's will remains forever' is v17.

sourceText: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ልባችንስ ባይፈርድብን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ድፍረት አለን፥
englishOfProposed: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
note: Amharic says: Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have boldness before God, 'Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, boldness toward God' is v21.

sourceText: ከእግዚአብሔር አብና ከአብ ልጅ ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ምሕረት ሰላምም በእውነትና በፍቅር ከእኛ ጋር ይሆናሉ።
englishOfProposed: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
note: Amharic says: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ the Son of the Father will be with us in truth and love. 'Grace, mercy, peace ... Son of the Father, in truth and love' is v3.

sourceText: ልጽፍልህ የምፈልገው ብዙ ነገር ነበረኝ፥ ዳሩ ግን በቀለምና በብርዕ ልጽፍልህ አልወድም፤
englishOfProposed: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
note: Amharic says: I had many things to write to you, but I do not want to write to you with ink and pen; 'Many things to write ... not with ink and pen' is v13.

sourceText: እነዚህ እንደ ምኞታቸው እየሄዱ የሚያንጎራጉሩና ስለ ዕድላቸው የሚያጕረመርሙ ናቸው፥ እንዲረባቸውም ለሰው ፊት እያደሉ አፋቸው ከመጠን ይልቅ ታላቅ ቃል ይናገራል።
englishOfProposed: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
note: Amharic says: These are grumblers and complainers about their lot, walking after their desires; their mouth speaks arrogant words, flattering people for advantage. 'Murmurers and complainers', 'walking after their lusts', 'proud speech', 'respect of persons for advantage' is v16.

sourceText: መንግሥትም ለአምላኩና ለአባቱም ካህናት እንድንሆን ላደረገ፥ ለእርሱ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ክብርና ኃይል ይሁን፤ አሜን።
englishOfProposed: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
note: Amharic says: To him who made us a kingdom, priests to his God and Father, to him be glory and power forever and ever; Amen. 'Made us a kingdom, priests to his God and Father ... glory and dominion forever, Amen' is v6.

sourceText: የንጋትንም ኮከብ እሰጠዋለሁ።
englishOfProposed: and I will give him the morning star.
note: Amharic says: And I will give him the morning star. 'Morning star' is v28.

sourceText: እንስሶቹም በዙፋን ላይ ለተቀመጠው ከዘላለምም እስከ ዘላለም በሕይወት ለሚኖረው ለእርሱ ክብርና ውዳሴ ምስጋናም በሰጡት ጊዜ፥
englishOfProposed: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,
note: Amharic says: And when the living creatures give glory, honor and thanks to him who sits on the throne, who lives forever and ever, 'Living creatures give glory, honor, thanks to him on the throne' is v9 (no elders or crowns from v10).

sourceText: አየሁም፥ በዙፋኑም በእንስሶቹም በሽማግሌዎቹም ዙሪያ የብዙ መላእክትን ድምፅ ሰማሁ፤ ቍጥራቸውም አእላፋት ጊዜ አእላፋትና ሺህ ጊዜ ሺህ ነበር፥
englishOfProposed: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,
note: Amharic says: And I looked, and I heard the voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures and the elders; their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands, 'Voice of many angels', 'ten thousands of ten thousands and thousands of thousands' is v11.

sourceText: ዓለሙንም ሁሉ የሚያስተው፥ ዲያብሎስና ሰይጣን የሚባለው ታላቁ ዘንዶ እርሱም የቀደመው እባብ ተጣለ፤ ወደ ምድር ተጣለ መላእክቱም ከእርሱ ጋር ተጣሉ።
englishOfProposed: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.
note: Amharic says: The great dragon, the ancient serpent called the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world, was thrown down; he was thrown to the earth and his angels were thrown down with him. 'Great dragon, old serpent, devil and Satan, deceiver of the world, thrown down to earth' is v9.

sourceText: ከዚህም በኋላ አየሁ፥ የምስክርም ድንኳን መቅደስ በሰማይ ተከፈተ፥
englishOfProposed: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
note: Amharic says: After this I looked, and the temple of the tent of witness in heaven was opened, 'After these things I looked', 'temple of the tabernacle of the testimony opened' is v5.

sourceText: የመቃጠልዋንም ጢስ ባዩ ጊዜ። ታላቂቱን ከተማ የምትመስላት ምን ከተማ ነበረች? እያሉ ጮኹ።
englishOfProposed: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’
note: Amharic says: When they saw the smoke of her burning, they cried out, 'What city was like the great city?' 'Smoke of her burning', 'What is like the great city?' is v18.

sourceText: ደግመውም። ሃሌ ሉያ አሉ፤ ጢስዋም ለዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ይወጣል።
englishOfProposed: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”
note: Amharic says: And again they said, 'Hallelujah!' and her smoke goes up forever and ever. Second 'Hallelujah' and 'her smoke goes up forever' is v3.

sourceText: በፈረሱም የተቀመጠውን ጭፍራዎቹንም ይወጉ ዘንድ አውሬውና የምድር ነገሥታት ጭፍራዎቻቸውም ተከማችተው አየሁ።
englishOfProposed: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.
note: Amharic says: And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered to make war against the one seated on the horse and his army. 'Beast, kings of the earth and their armies gathered against him who sat on the horse' is v19.

sourceText: ታላቅና ረጅም ቅጥር ነበራት፥ አሥራ ሁለትም ደጆች ነበሩአት በደጆቹም አሥራ ሁለት መላእክት ቆሙ፥ የአሥራ ሁለቱም የእስራኤል ልጆች ነገዶች ስሞች ተጽፈውባቸው ነበር።
englishOfProposed: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.
note: Amharic says: It had a great high wall, with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and on them were written the names of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel. 'Great high wall, twelve gates, twelve angels, names of the twelve tribes' is v12.
